belief: The highest elevation in Alaska is Denali at 20,310 feet, as officially measured by the U.S. Geological Survey in September 2015 and confirmed as of late November 2023.

author: worker_2
belief: The highest elevation in Texas is Guadalupe Peak at 8,751 feet above sea level, as stated by the U.S. National Park Service and Wikipedia.

author: worker_3
belief: The highest elevation in California is Mount Whitney at 14,505 feet (NAVD 88 datum), as officially measured by the National Geodetic Survey (NGS) and NOAA.

author: worker_4
belief: The highest elevation in Montana is Granite Peak at 12,807 feet (NAVD 88 datum), as per the National Geodetic Survey (NGS) Data Sheet.

author: worker_4
belief: The highest elevation in New Mexico is Wheeler Peak at 13,167 feet (NAVD 88 datum), as per the National Geodetic Survey (NGS) Data Sheet.
